subject: Renewal: SOC 2 evidence conveyance, retention change, and capacity top-up
messages:
From: Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@parkside.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@parkside.com, security@parkside.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal prep — SOC 2 evidence transport & retention/throughput asks

Hi Naomi,

Parkside's renewal is approaching (contract anniversary June 30). Security asked that we confirm a few items before our renewal conversation with procurement next week: 

- Can Redwood extend our audit log retention to 18 months for the account (standard is 12) and confirm any cost delta?
- We need a practical plan to deliver SOC 2 evidence artifacts and a secure transport option — ideally SFTP or presigned S3 transfer. Is there a playbook?
- Our workload is increasing; we'd like a temporary seat/top-up plan (additional reserved throughput for 60 days) during the evidence ingestion period. Any guidance on lead time?

I've attached a one-page summary of items we need. Procurement copied for timing.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Conway
Director, IT Compliance
Parkside Financial
[Attachment: Renewal-ask-parkside-0505.pdf (pdf)]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@parkside.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — SOC 2 evidence transport & retention/throughput asks

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Appreciated.

Quick answers up front:
- Retention: We can extend to 18 months. There's a pro-rated charge for extended retention; I'll get a precise estimate.
- Evidence transport: We support presigned S3 + signed transfer playbook; as an alternative we can provision a short-lived SFTP endpoint into a staging bucket. We have a documented manifest format for artifacts.
- Temporary capacity: we can provision a 60-day reserved throughput bump (reserved seats) with 7 days lead time to spin up GPUs in the region.

Looping in Ben (AM) to coordinate procurement/pricing and Kimberly from security to lay out the evidence checklist. Karthik, can you confirm the manifest template and whether we need any schema changes for Parkside's artifacts?

Next: I propose a brief alignment call Thursday 5/6 11am PT to walk procurement through the options and lock on lead times. Does that work for you?

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Renewals
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-Summary-2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@parkside.com>
Cc: procurement@parkside.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — SOC 2 evidence transport & retention/throughput asks

Thanks Naomi — and hi Lisa.

I can own pricing and procurement cadence. Ballpark pricing for 18mo retention vs 12mo: ~+12% on storage/retention line for the period, plus a one-time transfer fee depending on transfer method. For the 60-day capacity top-up we usually price as a short-term reserved add-on (monthly pro-rate) — I'll run exact numbers and include a pro-forma in the call.

Lisa — can procurement share the SOW window (preferred start/end dates for the top-up) and any PO timelines? That lets me produce a clean quote during the call.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Retention-Change-Request-Form.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@parkside.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — SOC 2 evidence transport & retention/throughput asks

Hi all,

Security team input: 
- Evidence manifest: we require a CSV manifest with artifact id, timestamp, type (log/snapshot/config), SHA256, and minimal metadata. Karthik, confirmed?
- Transfer: presigned S3 is preferred. If Parkside needs SFTP we can provision a temporary transfer bucket behind a VPC egress rule and short-lived credentials.
- Access: all evidence uploads must be to a staging bucket with object ACLs disabled; we will transfer to our compliance vault after validation.
- Audit trail: Redwood will supply an exportable audit log of uploads and object-level change events for the requested 18-month horizon. That is a separate retention charge as Ben noted.

Action items for our side: I'll produce the manifest template and an upload checklist by EOD Tuesday. Naomi/Ben — we'll need Parkside's target ingest window to flex the top-up timing.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Evidence-Manifest-parkview.csv (csv)]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@parkside.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@parkside.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: SOC 2 evidence conveyance, retention change, and capacity top-up

Lisa — thanks for aligning on the call last week. Recap and next steps so we have one single source of truth: 

1) Retention change: Redwood will extend Parkside's account audit log retention to 18 months. Pricing: Ben will issue a quote for the pro-rated retention delta and one-time transfer fee (expected +12% storage). Quote due 5/21.
2) Evidence transport: Parkside will use presigned S3 for bulk artifact transfer. Redwood will provide the manifest template and the presigned upload workflow. Kimberly attached the manifest template earlier; Karthik will confirm if we need additional columns for Parkside-specific metadata.
3) Temporary capacity: 60-day reserved seat top-up starting 2027-06-10 (Parkside preference). Redwood requires 7 calendar days lead time to provision in us-west-2; we will provision by 2027-06-03 to allow pre-warm. Ben to include the top-up line in the quote.
4) Audit trail: Redwood will export upload and object event logs to Parkside in a machine-readable form as part of the evidence bundle. These exports will be retained for 18 months once retention is active.

Open asks for Parkside: please confirm the desired start date for the 60-day top-up (Lisa/procurement) and confirm whether SFTP is required instead of presigned S3. If SFTP is required, provide an IP allowlist window.

I'll create a short mutual action plan (doc) and share it by EOD 5/20 with dates and deliverables for signatures.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Renewals, Redwood Inference
